# Temple Scroll Column 10 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 11QT (Cave 11), Col. 10 | **Condition:** Fragmentary; Festival calendar concludes

---

**10:1** [...] on the fifth [day], Gad and Asher [...]

**10:2** [...] on the sixth [day], Dan and Naphtali [...]

**10:3** [...] this is the day of the wood offering [...]

**10:4** [...] an everlasting statute throughout your generations [...]

**10:5** [...] in all your dwelling places, before the LORD [...]

**10:6** [...] and they shall praise the LORD their God [...]

**10:7** [...] who settled them in the land [...]

**10:8** [...] after these days [...] the memorial of the day [...]

**10:9** [...] the first day of the seventh month [...]

**10:10** [...] a memorial of trumpet blast [...] a holy convocation [...]

**10:11** [...] and you shall offer a burnt offering [...] an offering by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD [...]

**10:12** [...] one young bull [...] one ram [...] seven male lambs a year old [...]

---

*LOGOS notes: Column 10 closes the Wood Offering Festival (lines 1-5) and transitions to the autumnal festivals. Lines 6-7 include a praise formula for God's gift of the land. Lines 8-12 begin the Memorial of Trumpet Blasts on the first of the seventh month (cf. Lev 23:24, Num 29:1), prescribing a burnt offering of one bull, one ram, and seven yearling lambs.*
